title: Compute & close
covers: ITR-3 / ITR-5 JSON and the 3CD JSON
original, belated, revised and updated returns

steps.say: Turn the mapped books and 26AS into the return in SimplyFy: the computation, interest, the filing files in the department's own format, sign-off, filing and revisions.
The strip: mapped, reconciled, computed, signed off, filed, closed.
Each head adds its mapped rows; house property gets its 30%. Pick the regime here.
234A, 234B and 234C come from the 26AS challans by date; a senior citizen with no business income pays no advance-tax interest. Type a figure only to override.
On a refund, 244A interest at half a percent a month - none when the refund is under 10% of the tax.

The ITR JSON and, for an audit, the Form 3CB-3CD JSON - each checked against the CBDT schema before you download, with what is still missing listed. The balance sheet tallies and the P&L profit matches business income.
A reviewer signs off; then the acknowledgement number and date filed. The return type - original, belated, revised or ITR-U - follows from the dates.
Start a revised return, or an ITR-U after 31 December with its 140B additional tax; discard a revision; or undo a wrong 'filed' with a reason. Nothing filed is ever deleted.
Every change to this client and year, field by field - the regime, the interest typed in, sign-off, filing - with when and who.
